en.headline: Departments detail switchover plans for new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Immigration, Customs, Transport and Police set out clearance, transport and crowd arrangements for the 6.30am opening on Monday, when Lok Ma Chau services end.
body: The Immigration Department, Customs and Excise Department, Transport Department and Police Force released detailed arrangements for the opening of the redeveloped Huanggang Port at 6.30am on 12 October, the government said on Saturday.

Immigration clearance services will start at the new port at that time. Passengers arriving at the Lok Ma Chau Control Point or the temporary port building in Shenzhen before 6.30am will still be able to complete formalities. Eligible Hong Kong residents are urged to enrol in advance for collaborative inspection automated channels through the HK e-Channel app and to carry valid travel documents.

The new port will use joint one-stop vehicle lanes, where drivers complete both sides' checks in one pass via an integrated device collecting temperature, documents, facial features and fingerprints. General passengers of cross-boundary private cars must disembark and proceed on foot to the immigration hall. The last northbound Yellow Bus to the original port will leave San Tin Public Transport Interchange between 6.15am and 6.20am.

Police will set up a joint operation centre, demarcate public activity areas and implement crowd management at key locations including the San Tin interchange. The Security Bureau will activate an emergency monitoring centre. Travellers are advised to plan ahead and follow on-site instructions, as traffic near the ports may be busy in the early period.

zh.headline: 多部門公布新皇崗口岸周一轉換安排
zh.dek: 入境處、海關、運輸署及警務處詳列周一早上6時30分開通的清關、交通及人流安排，落馬洲服務屆時暫停。
body: 政府周六表示，入境事務處、香港海關、運輸署及警務處公布重新發展的皇崗口岸於10月12日早上6時30分開通的詳細安排。
新口岸屆時開始入境清關服務。上午6時30分前抵達落馬洲管制站或深圳臨時口岸大樓的旅客仍可完成手續。符合資格的香港居民應提前透過「香港e道」應用程式登記「協作查驗」自助通道，並攜帶有效旅遊證件。
新口岸採用「一站式」車輛通道，司機一次過完成雙方檢查，透過綜合資訊收集裝置錄取體溫、證件、面容及指紋。一般跨境私家車乘客須下車步行往入境大廳。最後一班往原口岸的北行黃巴士將於上午6時15分至6時20分從新田公共運輸交匯處開出。
警方將設立聯合行動中心，劃定公眾活動區並在新田交匯處等重點地點實施人流管理。保安局將啟動緊急監測中心。當局提醒旅客提前計劃行程及跟隨現場指示，初期口岸附近交通可能較繁忙。
